TaskDescription: Overnight sleep research recording session in the epilepsy monitoring unit; no task. Each file is a 1-5 min excerpt of sleep iEEG in which expert neurologists annotated interictal epileptiform discharges (Falach et al. 2024, Methods and Data Records).
iEEGReference: scalp: referenced to a central scalp electrode during acquisition (Falach et al. 2024, Methods: EEG Recordings). Channels named X-Y (where present) are bipolar derivations added by the authors to aid annotation.
iEEGPlacementScheme: Depth electrodes placed according to clinical needs for seizure-focus identification; channel selection for the dataset was based on availability, without consideration of IED presence (Falach et al. 2024, Methods: Participants, EEG Recordings).
iEEGElectrodeGroups: Channel names: initial letter = hemisphere (R/L), then 1-3 letters = brain region (e.g. A = amygdala, EC = entorhinal cortex, AH = anterior hippocampus; full list in derivatives/channels.tsv), then a contact number starting from 1 at the most mesial contact and increasing laterally (Falach et al. 2024, Methods: EEG Recordings). Contacts sharing a prefix belong to the same depth electrode.
